spf_record_termination_is_ok.description: Without an all mechanism or a redirect= modifier, receivers return neutral for senders the record does not list (RFC 7208 §4.7) — the same as ?all, so forged mail is not rejected. redirect= applies only when the record has no all.
spf_record_termination_is_ok.fix: redirect= applies only when the record has no all mechanism, and always after every mechanism. To use it, remove all and let the target's record end the policy (for example with -all); put redirect= at the end for readability. If you want to keep all, delete redirect=.
